customManagers.description: The cmake product shipyard's launchers run and its pkg requires (.mavergreen/ingredients/cmake/VERSION). install@v1 installs this release, verified against its SHA256SUMS; a bump releases shipyard on green.

The clang22 that builds shipyard's Sparkle updater on every host (.mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/VERSION). scripts/fetch_clang22.sh verifies its Linux archive against .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/LINUX_SHA256 and its pkgs against the release's SHA256SUMS.

The python-315 release ci.yml's on-target job installs in the 10.9 guest (.mavergreen/ingredients/python-315/VERSION). CI verifies the pkg against the release's SHA256SUMS; nothing of it ships, so a bump re-runs CI and releases nothing.
The ed25519-sign that signs every family release (.mavergreen/ingredients/ed25519/VERSION). sign_and_appcast.sh verifies the pkg against the release's SHA256SUMS.

The Recaulk whose librecaulk.a defines the C++ runtime machinery the conformance rule allows (.mavergreen/ingredients/recaulk/VERSION). cxxabi-allowlist.sh verifies the pkg against the release's SHA256SUMS.
The stevedore packager (.mavergreen/ingredients/stevedore/VERSION). fetch_stevedore.sh verifies the asset against the release's SHA256SUMS.
The Renovate release that validates default.json in CI (.mavergreen/ingredients/renovate/VERSION, read by linux-host.yml). Pinned so the check does not move without a commit.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/VERSION but cannot write the Linux archive's digest beside it, so the Linux job fails on the bump until .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/LINUX_SHA256 holds the new release's archive digest.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, write the digest of `clang22-<version>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` from the new release's SHA256SUMS, alone, to .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/LINUX_SHA256: `gh release download <version> -R Mavergreen/clang-22 -p SHA256SUMS -O - | awk '$2 ~ /linux-x86_64[.]tar[.]gz$/ { print $1 }' > .mavergreen/ingredients/clang22/LINUX_SHA256`.

packageRules.description: The renovate pin moves at most monthly: each bump costs macOS runner time in shipyard's CI and then its release, and the validator gains nothing from tracking Renovate's every release.
schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: linux-host.yml's setup-node runs Renovate's own config validator, whose package requires node ^24.11.0, so node stays on 24 until a renovate pin needs another major.
